Name: HarbourDocuments
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:row_to_json(harbours)⟩ AS row_document, ⟨c1 aliased:to_json(harbours)⟩ AS document, ⟨c2 aliased:to_jsonb(harbours)⟩ AS binary_document\nFROM harbours;

Name: HarbourRows
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: HarbourRows, command: many)
SELECT harbours, berths
FROM harbours
LEFT JOIN berths ON berths.harbour_id = harbours.id
WHERE harbours IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY harbours;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:harbours⟩, ⟨c1:berths⟩
FROM harbours
LEFT JOIN berths ON berths.harbour_id = harbours.id
WHERE harbours IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY harbours;

Name: AllHarbours
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: AllHarbours, command: one)
SELECT json_agg(h) AS harbours FROM harbours h;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:json_agg(h)⟩ AS harbours FROM harbours h;

Name: NamedHarbours
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: NamedHarbours, command: many)
SELECT v FROM harbour_names v;

Name: CountedRows
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: CountedRows, command: many)
SELECT counted FROM (SELECT harbour_id, count(*) AS total FROM berths GROUP BY harbour_id) counted;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:counted⟩ FROM (SELECT harbour_id, count(*) AS total FROM berths GROUP BY harbour_id) counted;

Name: PlanItems
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: PlanItems, command: many)
SELECT item FROM berths, jsonb_array_elements(berths.plan) AS item;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:item⟩ FROM berths, jsonb_array_elements(berths.plan) AS item;

Name: MooringCounts
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: MooringCounts, command: many)
SELECT moorings FROM moorings;
